items.claim: Islam Dulatov comes forward, throws punches, and is a striker with power, movement, and body/leg work.
items.quote: He comes forward. He starts throwing. He's a striker. He's got power, plenty of movement, does a really good job working the body and the legs.

items.claim: Islam Dulatov has solid takedown defense and some offensive submissions.
items.quote: His takedown defense is pretty solid as well, and he has some offensive submissions if they end up on the ground.

items.claim: Islam Dulatov knocked out Adam Fugitt last year.
items.quote: He knocked out Adam Fugitt last year around this time

items.claim: Wellington Turman is coming off a three-year layoff without fighting.
items.quote: Then he took a three-year layoff and now here he is back after three years no fighting.

items.claim: Wellington Turman is a good grappler who will find and chase submissions from scrambles.
items.quote: When he does fight he's a good grappler. He will find submissions. He'll chase them.

items.claim: Ramazan Temirov moves forward as a lightning-fast striker with crazy power.
items.quote: Ramazan Temirov's a guy that's going to move forward. He's a lightning fast striker. He's got tiny little legs. He's not a big dude but he's got crazy power.

items.claim: Ramazan Temirov can be rocked but weathers it and continues to fight forward.
items.quote: it doesn't take a ton of tape study to see that he can be rocked, but he just weathers, he moves forward, and he continues to fight.

items.claim: Ramazan Temirov was suspended for a tainted supplement in his heart medication.
items.quote: he did get suspended for a tainted tainted supplement, but we're not talking steroids. It was something like in his heart medication.

items.claim: Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has evolved, added striking, and possesses high fight IQ.
items.quote: I think Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has evolved, added some striking, and I think he's high IQ.

items.claim: Steve Erceg was knocked out by Kai Kara-France.
Magomed Ankalaev is long, uses length well, and has wrestling as a backup plan.
items.quote: He's long, he uses length pretty well. He has wrestling as a backup plan.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev was sick or injured going into his fight against Alex Pereira.
items.quote: What was he? Sick or injured, whatever it was going into his last fight, I believe it.

items.claim: Bogdan Guskov is stepping up on two weeks' notice.
items.quote: Bogdan Guskov is stepping up on two weeks notice. Now, he was in camp. He was supposed to be fighting next week, he's fighting this week

items.claim: Bogdan Guskov has big one-punch knockout power and can head hunt.
items.quote: Bogdan Guskov does have big one-punch knockout power, and he can head hunt, and he can find that spot.
